story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. The engawa veranda of grandma's Kyoto machiya with shoji and a small garden (kit place: veranda); summer day and night
2. The Gion festival street lined with lantern-lit stalls, paved with grey stone (kit place: market); dusk
3. Grandma's tatami room with a low table (kit place: tea-room); night

KEY OBJECT (the owner's notes — draw it exactly so): The Edo fūrin (glass wind chime): a small TRANSPARENT glass bell, open at the bottom, with a white highlight on the glass and a painted pattern; a clapper hanging inside the bell; a short string from the top of the bell to the eaves; a long paper strip (tanzaku) hanging below on a thread. NOT brass, NOT rods. States in order: still (the bell and strip hanging straight down, the strip plain) → ringing (the bell tilted, the paper strip — now the blue wish strip — lifted sideways by the wind, small motion lines).

夏休み、ゆいは、京都のおばあちゃんの家に、遊びに来ました。縁側には、古い江戸風鈴が、ひとつ下がっていますが、もう、音が鳴りません。「おじいちゃんと買った風鈴なの」と、おばあちゃんは、言いました。夕方、二人は、浴衣を着て、祇園祭の宵山へ、出かけました。提灯の灯る通りには、屋台が、ずらりと並んでいます。風鈴の屋台で、ゆいは、青い短冊を、一枚選びました。夜、家に帰ると、ゆいは、短冊に、願いごとを書きました。「おばあちゃんの風鈴が、また、鳴りますように」。ゆいが、短冊を風鈴に結ぶと、夜風が、そっと吹きました。ちりん。風鈴が、ひさしぶりに、鳴りました。おばあちゃんは、そっと涙をふいて、ゆいの頭を、なでました。

cast.name: Yui
cast.look: A small girl, 7 years old, short black hair in a bob, wearing a light cotton yukata with pastel floral pattern, bare feet on tatami. Signature detail: a red hair ribbon.

cast.name: Grandma
cast.look: Elderly woman, gentle smile, silver hair in a neat bun, wearing a dark indigo kimono with subtle crane embroidery, wooden geta sandals. Signature detail: a silver pendant necklace.

cast.name: Edo Fūrin
cast.look: Small transparent glass bell, open at the bottom, white highlight on glass, painted pattern inside, metal clapper hanging inside, short string from top to eaves, long paper strip (tanzaku) hanging below on thread. Still state: bell and strip hang straight, strip plain white. Ringing state: bell tilted, blue wish strip lifted sideways with subtle motion lines.

states.look: Bell and strip hang straight down; strip plain white.
Bell tilted; blue wish strip lifted sideways with faint motion lines.

parts.look: small transparent bell-shaped bulb, open at the bottom, a thin white highlight on the curve, faint painted pattern visible inside the glass wall
tiny rod or bead hanging from the bell's inner centre, just above the open mouth, dull metal glint
thin cord from the bell's top knob up to the eaves, slack but straight, same length as the bell height
narrow vertical rectangle of paper, width about one-third the bell width, length four to five times the bell height, hangs on a fine thread from the clapper or bell bottom
near-invisible fine line joining the strip top to the bell's lower centre

notLike: brass tube wind chime with rods

states.change: bell and paper strip hang perfectly vertical; strip is plain white, no writing visible
bell tilted noticeably to one side; paper strip — now blue with handwritten wish — lifted sideways by wind, faint curved motion lines beside it

cast.name: Engawa Veranda
cast.look: Engawa veranda of a Kyoto machiya, wooden floor, shoji sliding screens, small garden with mossy stones and a lantern, summer daylight filtering through screens.

cast.name: Gion Festival Street
cast.look: Gion festival street at dusk, grey stone pavement, rows of lantern-lit stalls with colorful awnings, crowds in yukata, soft glow.

cast.name: Tatami Tea Room
cast.look: Tatami tea-room, low wooden table, shoji screen to garden, paper lantern, night shadows.

shots.description: Wide shot of the engawa veranda in summer daylight, Yui walks onto the wooden floor toward Grandma who sits near the shoji screens; the Edo fūrin hangs straight and still from the eaves. Time: summer day, bright sunlight.
shots.dialogue: 夏休み、ゆいは、京都のおばあちゃんの家に、遊びに来ました。

shots.description: Medium shot focusing on the fūrin, the glass bell and white paper strip hanging motionless in the gentle breeze, the veranda background blurred. Time: summer day, bright sunlight.
shots.dialogue: 縁側には、古い江戸風鈴が、ひとつ下がっていますが、もう、音が鳴りません。

shots.description: Close-up on Grandma's face as she gestures toward the fūrin, Yui looks up attentively from beside her. Time: summer day, bright sunlight.
shots.dialogue: 「おじいちゃんと買った風鈴なの」と、おばあちゃんは、言いました。

shots.description: Wide shot of the Gion festival street at dusk, grey stone pavement glows with lantern light, Yui and Grandma in yukata stroll past rows of stalls. Time: dusk, lantern glow.
shots.dialogue: 夕方、二人は、浴衣を着て、祇園祭の宵山へ、出かけました。

shots.description: Medium shot of a fūrin stall, several glass bells hang from the eaves, their paper strips plain, lanterns flicker. Time: dusk, lantern glow.
shots.dialogue: 提灯の灯る通りには、屋台が、ずらりと並んでいます。

shots.description: Close-up of Yui's hand selecting a blue tanzaku strip from the stall, the strip's color vivid against the stall's wood. Time: dusk, lantern glow.
shots.dialogue: 風鈴の屋台で、ゆいは、青い短冊を、一枚選びました。

shots.description: Medium shot inside the tatami tea-room at night, low table illuminated by a paper lantern, Yui sits writing on the blue strip. Time: night, lantern glow.
shots.dialogue: 夜、家に帰ると、ゆいは、短冊に、願いごとを書きました。

shots.description: Close-up of the blue tanzaku now bearing the wish in delicate brush strokes, the paper rests on the table. Time: night, lantern glow.
shots.dialogue: 「おばあちゃんの風鈴が、また、鳴りますように」。

shots.description: Low angle from the veranda floor showing Yui tying the blue strip to the fūrin's thread, Grandma watches from the side as a night wind stirs the garden. Time: night, gentle breeze.
shots.dialogue: ゆいが、短冊を風鈴に結ぶと、夜風が、そっと吹きました。

shots.description: Close-up of the fūrin now ringing, the glass bell tilted, the blue strip lifted sideways with faint motion lines, a soft 'chirin' resonates. Time: night, gentle breeze.
shots.dialogue: ちりん。風鈴が、ひさしぶりに、鳴りました。

shots.description: Medium shot on the veranda, Grandma gently wipes a tear and strokes Yui's head, the fūrin's faint chime lingers in the night air. Time: night, gentle breeze.
shots.dialogue: おばあちゃんは、そっと涙をふいて、ゆいの頭を、なでました。
